participant_a_prompt_text: Your partner will tell you about a time when they felt like you weren't being understanding or empathetic. Listen to their concerns and discuss how you can improve your communication and empathy in similar situations in the future.
participant_b_prompt_text: Tell your partner about a situation where you wish you had been more empathetic or understanding towards someone. Describe what happened and how you think you could have responded in a more sensitive way.
